payload.name: Compress Image to 10KB by PrintableTools Lab
payload.short_description: Free no-signup 10KB image compressor for extremely strict upload limits.
payload.long_description: A free browser-based image compressor for extremely strict 10KB upload limits on profile, exam, school, and application forms. It runs locally in the browser, requires no account and no server file upload, and includes an optional USD 9 Upload Limit Fix Plan request after a public-safe fit check.
